name: ES Mean Reversion — Bollinger Bands & Z-Score
description: Mean reversion strategy on E-mini S&P 500 (ES) futures. Uses a 20-period Z-score to identify statistically extreme price deviations (±2σ) and fades them back to the mean. Bollinger Bands provide visual confirmation of overbought/oversold zones. Positions are sized using ATR-based risk units (1% account risk per trade, 2×ATR stop loss) for volatility-adjusted exposure. Long when price is significantly below the mean (oversold), short when significantly above (overbought) — exits fire when price reverts to the rolling mean.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ES FUTURES MEAN REVERSION — BOLLINGER BANDS & Z-SCORE
# =============================================================================
# LOGIC:
#   Entry Long  : Z-score < -2  (price > 2 std devs below 20-day mean → oversold)
#   Entry Short : Z-score > +2  (price > 2 std devs above 20-day mean → overbought)
#   Exit Long   : Z-score >= 0  (price reverts to or above rolling mean)
#   Exit Short  : Z-score <= 0  (price reverts to or below rolling mean)
#   Stop Loss   : 2 × ATR(14) from entry price
#   Sizing      : 1% account risk per trade via ATR stop distance
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE & FUTURES CONTINUATION
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()

# Stitch individual contracts into a continuous, gap-free price series
cont = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=1D,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
high  = cont.h
low   = cont.l

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# Bollinger Bands (20-period, 2σ) — auto-plotted as price chart overlay
bands  = bbands(period=20, stddev=2)(close)
upper  = bands.bbands_upper
middle = bands.bbands_middle
lower  = bands.bbands_lower

# Z-score (20-period): normalizes close to standard deviations from rolling mean
# Threshold +2 / -2 = statistically extreme price deviation
zscore_val = zscore(window=20)(close)

# ATR (14-period) — measures daily volatility for stop distance; auto-plotted
atr14     = atr(period=14)(high, low, close)
stop_dist = 2 * atr14

# =============================================================================
# MEAN REVERSION SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# LONG: Price significantly below mean (oversold)
# HOLD until Z-score reverts to 0 (mean reversion achieved)
long_signal  = zscore_val < -2
long_exit    = zscore_val >= 0
held_long    = hold_until()(enter=long_signal, exit=long_exit)

# SHORT: Price significantly above mean (overbought)
# HOLD until Z-score reverts to 0 (mean reversion achieved)
short_signal = zscore_val > 2
short_exit   = zscore_val <= 0
held_short   = hold_until()(enter=short_signal, exit=short_exit)

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Wire front contract for rollover management (required for futures strategies)
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)

# Open long/short zones; hold_until already converts pulses → continuous zones
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# ATR-based position sizing: 1% account risk per trade, stop = 2× ATR
# risk_unit atomically computes: position_size = (equity × 1%) / stop_distance
risk_unit(stop_unit='price')(risk_pct=1, stop_distance=stop_dist)

# =============================================================================
# Z-SCORE CHART PANEL
# =============================================================================

# Z-score has no auto-plot (plotKind=None) — add as a chart pane
# Shows normalized price position with ±2σ and mean reference lines
timeseries_lines(
    title="Z-Score (20-period)",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Z-Score", color=Color.Info)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2,  title="Overbought +2σ", color=Color.Error),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2, title="Oversold -2σ",   color=Color.Success),
        ReferenceLine(value=0,  title="Mean",            color=Color.Muted)
    ])
)(zscore_val)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Mark long entries (oversold — fade to mean)
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Long Entry — Oversold",
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close",          type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Lower Band",     type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Z-Score",        type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Stop Dist (2×ATR)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, lower, zscore_val, stop_dist, long_signal)

# Mark short entries (overbought — fade to mean)
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Short Entry — Overbought",
    icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close",          type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Upper Band",     type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Z-Score",        type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Stop Dist (2×ATR)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, upper, zscore_val, stop_dist, short_signal)
